answer: Lantern citation bond: each identity locks 70 credits, citing one deed from the lantern ledger. Its ember: 30 credits of work proving the deed glows. A peer may whisper a dispute for 5; auditors replay the deed, and a false citation burns the bond while a false whisper loses its 5. Rented citations fail: one deed, two bonds burned. First 30, k-th 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,027,000, pool 40,000. Honest agents cite one deed, paying 30 once.
